usage.guide: POST a JSON body {"text": "..."} to https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/extract with x402 payment ($0.02 USDC on Base). The response is plain sync JSON. Read entities from body.entities, which is an object of typed arrays: people, organizations, locations, dates, emails, urls, phone_numbers, amounts. body.total_entities gives the count. No auth or polling needed.
